run_GibbsSamplerPlackettLuce_sample: run the Gibbs sampler for Plackett-Luce distribution on multiple partial rankings
run_GibbsSamplerPlackettLuce_sample_from: run the PL Gibbs sampler that either ignores or collects unseen classes
run_GibbsSamplerPlackettLuce_sample_tau_: sample arrival times tau given permutation and latent plausibilities
run_GibbsSamplerPlackettLuce_sample_lam_: sample latent plausibilities lambda given arrival times
run_GibbsSamplerPlackettLuce_sample_perm: sample full rankings for each reader given lambda and partial rankings
